allow: PowerShell($g = Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { $g.Source; gh run list --limit 5 } else { "gh not found on PATH" })

PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:ProgramFiles\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe","$env:ProgramFiles\(x86\)\\GitHub CLI\\gh.exe"\); $found = $paths | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }; if \($found\) { "FOUND: $found" } else { "not in standard locations"; Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\\" -Filter gh.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Depth 4 | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty FullName })
